name: Megaventory
description_en:
Megaventory combines cloud inventory, purchase/sales orders and manufacturing tracking. The official site describes multi-location stock, partial receipts and shipments, serial/batch information and work orders tied to bills of materials.

Its distinctive evaluation path is to connect order fulfillment with component consumption and finished-goods receipts. It may suit a business assembling products as well as selling them, provided the documented capacity and transaction model fit.
description_zh:
Megaventory 结合云库存、采购销售订单及制造跟踪。官网描述多地点库存、部分收发货、序列号与批次信息，以及关联物料清单的工单。

评估可将订单履约与组件消耗、成品入库相连。对于既组装又销售商品的企业有相关性，但需确认容量和交易模型符合需求。

core_features.explanation_en: The product lists transfers, landed costs, returns, partial shipping/receiving and consignment/drop-ship flows.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品列出转移、到岸成本、退货、部分收发货及寄售和直发流程。

core_features.explanation_en: BOMs, component allocation, partial finished-goods receipt and work-in-process/labor costs are described.
core_features.explanation_zh: 文档描述物料清单、组件分配、部分成品入库及在制品与工时成本。

sections.title_en: Build a finished item from stocked components
sections.title_zh: 使用在库组件生产成品
sections.en: Create components, a BOM and locations, allocate components to a work order and receive only part of the finished quantity. Then ship a customer order and inspect remaining components, work in process and finished stock. Add a supplier return to check cost and quantity effects. This proposed sequence targets the interaction of manufacturing and fulfillment rather than a feature checklist.
sections.zh: 创建组件、物料清单和地点，将组件分配到工单，仅接收部分成品，再发出客户订单并检查组件余量、在制品和成品库存。加入供应商退货以核查数量与成本影响。该建议重点验证制造和履约的相互作用。

sections.en: Pro lists five users, 20 locations, 20,000 products, 20,000 clients, 50,000 transactions and one company. Transactions are labeled consignments/invoices/bills, not simply units sold. Extra users and blocks of 25,000 transactions are separately priced, with published ceilings of 35 users and 200,000 transactions before a custom plan. Confirm the transaction accounting period and archive treatment.
sections.zh: Pro 列出五用户、20 地点、20,000 商品、20,000 客户、50,000 交易及一家公司。交易标为寄售单、发票和账单，并非售出件数。额外用户及每 25,000 交易单独计费，定制方案前公布上限为 35 用户和 200,000 交易。应确认交易统计周期及归档处理。

sections.en: The pricing section exposes monthly/annual controls, advertises a 10% annual discount and shows Pro at $135 per month in the text snapshot. It also contains $27/$30 per-user equivalents, so the alternate billing amount should be confirmed rather than reconstructed as an offer. Extra users and transaction blocks show $45 monthly each. API, application modules and integrations are described as included; turnkey onboarding is optional.
sections.zh: 价格区有月付和年付控制，宣传年付九折，文本快照显示 Pro 每月 $135，同时含每用户 $27/$30 的两种折算值，因此其他周期金额应确认，不能自行还原为报价。额外用户及交易块各标 $45/月。API、应用模块和集成说明包含，完整上线服务可选。

sections.title_en: Test mobile counts and access rights
sections.title_zh: 测试移动盘点与访问权
sections.en: The site offers a 15-day trial and describes Android/iOS scanning for orders, receiving, packing and inventory taking. Teams with assembly and multi-location stock can evaluate this combined scope. Check whether permissions isolate locations and whether a count/import can be corrected without losing history. Backup/restore is advertised but was not executed; no recovery guarantee is independently established.
sections.zh: 官网提供 15 天试用，并描述 Android/iOS 的订单、收货、包装和盘点扫描。有组装与多地点库存的团队可评估组合范围。应检查权限是否隔离地点，以及盘点或导入能否在保留历史的前提下修正。备份恢复虽有宣传但未执行，未独立确认恢复保证。
